verdict.rationale: Docusign markets workflow automation through its IAM platform, with configurable workflows, drag-and-drop contract process design, auto-population from Salesforce, and workflow actions triggerable via its MCP server. However, nothing documents automations running autonomously in the background: no event triggers, scheduling or unattended agent execution, and the agent/MCP flows appear user-initiated. Missing for 10: explicit background/unattended execution (triggers, schedules, webhooks), documentation of autonomous agent runs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
